answer_1.quote: Recent advancements in natural language transformation (e.g., machine translation and text style transfer) have been significantly driven by large language models (LLMs).

answer_2.quote: For neural metrics, we adopted the XCOMET series models, and for statistical metrics, we used BLEU.

answer_3.quote: For this evaluation task, we adopted the LLM-as-Judge method as the main evaluation metric, leveraging the capabilities of large language models to assess the quality, fluency, and stylistic consistency of the generated text.
